source.author: verg
source.text: Tempus desistere pugnae; solus ego in Pallanta feror, soli mihi Pallas debetur; cuperem ipse parens spectator adesset.
source.text_original: 'Tempus desistere pugnae; / solus ego in Pallanta feror, soli mihi Pallas / debetur; cuperem ipse parens spectator adesset.'
source.text_english: It is time to cease the battle; I alone am being borne against Pallas, Pallas is owed to me alone; I could wish his father himself were here as a spectator.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: mox Scythiae spoliis nuribusque superbus adveniet; cuperem ipse graves turn rumpere terras.
reuse.text_original: mox Scythiae spoliis nuribusque superbus / adveniet; cuperem ipse graves turn rumpere terras.
reuse.text_english: Soon he will arrive, proud with the spoils of Scythia and with brides; I should like then myself to burst the heavy earth.
